name: hang_laundry
text: A person stands facing a clothes rail. Start holding the two upper corners of a shirt at chest height, hands thirty-four centimeters apart. Smoothly raise both hands forward above the head, drape the shirt over a horizontal rail, release both corners after a short pause, then lower both empty arms naturally. Keep feet planted and stay in front of the rail. No crossing the wrists. One clear hanging action.
